Class CostLedger

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.securityaccount.CostLedger
public final class CostLedger extends Object
The open purchases of one security in one security account, in the order they were bought. A sale consumes them from the head (FIFO) or from the tail (LIFO).

The ledger only keeps quantities and costs. It does not decide what an uncovered sale costs: it reports the units no lot covered and leaves the substitute to the caller, because the callers disagree about it.

    • reduce

      public CostLedger.Reduction reduce(double unitsToReduce, CostBasisMethod method)
      Consumes lots for a sale. A lot that is used up hands over its whole cost, a partly used lot the proportional share, so no cost remainder is left behind. A lot whose remaining units round to zero counts as used up. When the units of the ledger round to zero, whatever is left goes to this sale as well and the ledger is emptied, so that a closed position cannot come back as the oldest lot of a later purchase.
      Parameters:
      unitsToReduce - units of the sale on the split basis of the report date
      method - CostBasisMethod.FIFO or CostBasisMethod.LIFO
      Returns:
      the consumed parts, their cost and the units that no lot covered
